checks.note: Manifest, prompts and config are tracked and read from the repo checkout (src/config.ts, loop.ts). CODEOWNERS covers /prompts/, /config/ and /release/, and branch protection requires code-owner review, last-push approval and enforces admins.

The catch-all * line is overridden by later specific owners for prompts, config, release, infra, k8s and .github. The deploy role is assumable only from the production and production-emergency environments, and both require a leads reviewer with prevent_self_review. The runtime role cannot change production config.

checks.quote:
kubectl -n clinic-agent rollout status deployment/clinic-agent --timeout=5m
- name: Open follow-up review for emergency change
  if: inputs.emergency
checks.note: The follow-up review issue is created only in the last step, which carries no always() or failure() condition, so it runs only if everything before it succeeded. The change is already applied by kubectl apply at line 74. If rollout status times out or fails, or the later gh issue create fails (invalid assignee or missing label), the emergency change is live and no follow-up review is opened. The path also does not enforce the end date; it only writes it into the issue text.

note: The emergency path applies the change before it opens the follow-up review issue, and a failed rollout or issue step leaves a live emergency change with no follow-up record.
